newsitem.title: USA: Medical Resources adopts shareholder plan.
newsitem.headline: Medical Resources adopts shareholder plan.

text.p: Medical Resources Inc said Wednesday its board has adopted a shareholders' rights plan as a defensive measure in the event of a takeover attempt.

With the plan, the board declared a dividend to be made to stockholders of record on September 24 of one Series C Junior participating preferred share purchase right for each outstanding share of Medical common stock, the company said.

No rights would be distributed unless there were an attempt to buy at least 15 percent of Medical's common stock. The company said it is unaware of any intentions to make a tender offer for its common stock.
Separately, Medical Resources said it has obtained an additional $4 million revolving line of credit on top of its $17 million in revolving and capital lease lines of credit.
